<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that involve a carbon‑carbon double bond converting to a single bond (C=C → C‑C), which is characteristic of the Diels‑Alder cycloaddition. The required bond‑order change format is "6-6 (2.0->1.0)".</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
    "bonds_order_changed": ["6-6 (2.0->1.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
